scope: Curated data/yume-photo-index.json (sport, Asia, Japan and global public portrait records). This is a source and URL audit, not visual facial identity verification.
limitations: Profiles without indexed portraits are not represented in this file-level audit.
A successful HTTP response does not prove a photograph visually depicts its named subject.
Identity is supported by Wikidata or a manually recorded Commons category/file source; uncertain matches are not auto-added.
